descripcion: Bar and café, restaurant, terrace and hotel: bar counters with their stools, tables and chairs, pub games, buffet, terrace furniture, lobby, guest room, corridors and function room.

subcategorias.acera_terraza: On the pavement and the façade

barra_recta.descripcion: Bar counter at chest height, with a foot rail a hand's width above the floor that the cane touches first. Follow it by hand to its end.
barra_recta.imagen: Footprint of “Straight bar counter”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

barra_ele.descripcion: Bar counter turning the corner in an L, closing the bartender in against the wall. Following it by hand you feel the turn; foot rail on the outside.
barra_ele.imagen: Footprint of “L-shaped bar counter”: an L shape, 3.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

barra_curva.descripcion: Bar counter bulging into the room in a half moon, with no corners. It has a foot rail; behind it, against the wall, is the bartender's space.
barra_curva.imagen: Footprint of “Curved bar counter”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.20 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

barra_paso_abatible.descripcion: A section of the bar that lifts like a lid, with a small gate below: this is where the bartender goes in and out. Down, it blocks the way; lifted, you walk through.
barra_paso_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Lift-up flap of the bar”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

barra_tramo_bajo.descripcion: A section of the bar lowered to table height, with knee space underneath. Following the bar by hand, it drops a step here.
barra_tramo_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low accessible bar section”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

contrabarra.descripcion: Long low unit against the wall, behind the bar, with doors and shelves. The coffee machine and the grinder stand on it.
contrabarra.imagen: Footprint of “Back bar unit”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

taburete_barra_fijo.descripcion: Tall stool bolted to the floor: a metal post and a round seat that swivels. It does not move if you bump it; there are usually several in a row.
taburete_barra_fijo.imagen: Footprint of “Fixed tall bar stool”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

taburete_barra_respaldo.descripcion: Loose tall stool on four legs with a foot ring and a short backrest. It is light: push it and it scrapes along or tips over.
taburete_barra_respaldo.imagen: Footprint of “Tall bar stool with backrest”: a rectangle, 0.42 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

cafetera_expres.descripcion: Large metal coffee machine on the back counter, at chest height. Hot to the touch; the hiss of its steam carries across the bar and tells you where the counter is.
cafetera_expres.imagen: Footprint of “Bar espresso machine”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.55 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

molinillo_cafe.descripcion: Grinder next to the coffee machine: a plastic hopper on top and a lever that clacks as it doses. It whines for a few seconds while grinding.
molinillo_cafe.imagen: Footprint of “Coffee grinder”: a rectangle, 0.22 by 0.35 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Mc”.

grifo_cerveza.descripcion: Cold, wet metal column rising from the bar, with the tap handles on top. Below it is a drip grille.
grifo_cerveza.imagen: Footprint of “Beer tap tower”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gc”.

camara_botellero.descripcion: Low steel cooler with sliding lids on top or doors at the front. It hums all the time: it tells you which is the bartender's side.
camara_botellero.imagen: Footprint of “Under-counter bottle cooler”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

lavavasos.descripcion: Small glasswasher under the bar. When running you hear pressurised water for a couple of minutes; hot steam comes out when it is opened.
lavavasos.imagen: Footprint of “Bar glasswasher”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

tpv_bar.descripcion: Till with a screen and cash drawer, at the end of the bar at chest height. It beeps when taking payment and the drawer springs open with a bell.
tpv_bar.imagen: Footprint of “Bar till”: a rectangle, 0.38 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

cubitera_pie.descripcion: Metal bucket with ice and a bottle, on a thin waist-high stand. Cold and wet; knock it and it wobbles and the ice rattles.
cubitera_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Ice bucket on a stand”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

vitrina_tapas.nombre: Tapas display case on the bar
vitrina_tapas.descripcion: Low glass case standing along the bar, cold to the touch. It takes up the space where you would rest your arm; the cane gives no warning.
vitrina_tapas.imagen: Footprint of “Tapas display case on the bar”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.38 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vt”.

expositor_bolleria.descripcion: Clear plastic case with a flip lid, on the counter, holding croissants and muffins. Light: it slides if you push it with your elbow.
expositor_bolleria.imagen: Footprint of “Counter pastry display”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Eb”.

vitrina_tartas.descripcion: Round glass column as tall as a person, cold, with cakes on slowly turning shelves. It hums quietly.
vitrina_tartas.imagen: Footprint of “Rotating cake display”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vt”.

botellero_pared.nombre: Wall bottle shelves behind the bar
botellero_pared.descripcion: Glass shelves of bottles hung on the wall behind the bar, from chest height to above the head. The cane passes underneath.
botellero_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall bottle shelves behind the bar”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bp”.

copas_colgadas.nombre: Hanging glass rack above the bar
copas_colgadas.descripcion: Metal rack hung from the ceiling above the bar, with glasses upside down at forehead height. The cane misses it; a raised hand does not.
copas_colgadas.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging glass rack above the bar”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

jamones_colgados.descripcion: A row of hams hanging from a ceiling rail, their tips at head height. Soft and greasy to the touch; you can smell them from a distance.
jamones_colgados.imagen: Footprint of “Hams hanging above the bar”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.65 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Jc”.

mesa_alta_bar.nombre: Tall bar table with foot rail
mesa_alta_bar.descripcion: Tall, narrow table at chest height, with a ring or bar for the feet. Used standing or with tall stools; the top overhangs the legs.
mesa_alta_bar.imagen: Footprint of “Tall bar table with foot rail”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

barril_mesa.descripcion: Upright wine barrel with iron hoops, used as a tall table. Pot-bellied: wider in the middle than at the top; it sounds hollow when struck.
barril_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Barrel used as a table”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

velador_marmol.descripcion: Small round café table: a cold marble top on a central iron leg with three feet at the bottom. Very heavy; it does not move.
velador_marmol.imagen: Footprint of “Marble café table”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vm”.

mesa_bar_pie_central.descripcion: Bar table on a single central leg with a wide iron base on the floor: the cane hits the base before the top. The chairs go round it.
mesa_bar_pie_central.imagen: Footprint of “Pedestal bar table”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

silla_apilable_bar.descripcion: Light tubular metal chair without arms, the stacking kind. It scrapes and squeals when pushed; never in the same place twice.
silla_apilable_bar.imagen: Footprint of “Stackable café chair”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

sillas_apiladas.descripcion: A tower of chairs nested into each other, pushed against a wall. Taller than a chair, with legs sticking out at several heights; here today, gone tomorrow.
sillas_apiladas.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of chairs”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

banco_corrido_pared.descripcion: Long padded bench along the wall with a high back. Tables are lined up in front; to sit you slide in sideways between two of them.
banco_corrido_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Upholstered wall banquette”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

banco_corrido_rincon.descripcion: Padded bench turning the corner in an L, with the table tucked into the angle. Whoever sits at the far end is hemmed in by the others.
banco_corrido_rincon.imagen: Footprint of “Corner banquette”: an L shape, 2.20 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

reservado_bar.nombre: Booth with two benches and table
reservado_bar.descripcion: Two high-backed benches facing each other, with a fixed table between them coming out from the wall. You slide in sideways from the aisle.
reservado_bar.imagen: Footprint of “Booth with two benches and table”: two facing benches with the table between them, coming out from the wall, 1.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rb”.

tragaperras.descripcion: Tall sheet-metal cabinet against the wall, with buttons at waist height and a tray at the bottom. Its jingle never stops: the best landmark in the bar.
tragaperras.imagen: Footprint of “Slot machine”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

maquina_tabaco.descripcion: Wide, shallow sheet-metal cabinet near the entrance, with rows of buttons and a drawer at the bottom where the pack drops.
maquina_tabaco.imagen: Footprint of “Cigarette machine”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

maquina_bolas.descripcion: Plastic globe of gumballs or nuts on a metal stand, at chest height. It has a coin dial and a little flap below.
maquina_bolas.imagen: Footprint of “Gumball and nut machine”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

futbolin.descripcion: Table football: a waist-high wooden box with metal rods running through it and sticking out on both long sides. The rods move by themselves if someone is playing.
futbolin.imagen: Footprint of “Table football”: a long box with four rods sticking out at the front and at the back, 1.50 by 1.15 metres, marked with the letters “Fu”.

mesa_billar.descripcion: Large, heavy pool table, with a wooden rim at hip height and cloth inside. Room must be left all round for the cues.
mesa_billar.imagen: Footprint of “Pool table”: a rectangle, 2.54 by 1.42 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

taquera_billar.descripcion: Wooden wall rack holding the cues upright, from hip height to above the head. It sticks out a hand's width and the cues fall if you brush them.
taquera_billar.imagen: Footprint of “Wall cue rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.12 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

diana_dardos.descripcion: Plastic cabinet hung on the wall with the board at face height. The throwing lane in front must be kept clear: do not cross while someone is throwing.
diana_dardos.aviso: Darts area: do not cross while someone is throwing.
diana_dardos.imagen: Footprint of “Wall electronic dartboard”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dd”.

tv_brazo_bar.nombre: Bar television on a wall arm
tv_brazo_bar.descripcion: Television hanging from an arm that comes out of the wall or the corner, at head height. The cane passes underneath; you hear it when it is on.
tv_brazo_bar.imagen: Footprint of “Bar television on a wall arm”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

percha_pared_balda.nombre: Wall coat rack with hat shelf
percha_pared_balda.descripcion: A row of hooks with a shelf above, on the wall at head height. With coats on it bulges a good hand and a half and the cane does not find it.
percha_pared_balda.imagen: Footprint of “Wall coat rack with hat shelf”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.55 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pp”.

paraguero_rejilla.descripcion: Low metal box with a grid of holes for many umbrellas, by the door. The floor around it is usually wet.
paraguero_rejilla.imagen: Footprint of “Shop-entrance umbrella rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

mesa_banquete_redonda.descripcion: Large round table with a floor-length cloth: the cane meets soft fabric, not legs. The chairs crowd round it and it is hard to get between two tables.
mesa_banquete_redonda.imagen: Footprint of “Round banquet table”: a circle, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

mesa_restaurante_vestida.descripcion: Four-legged restaurant table with a cloth, glasses and cutlery on it: pull the cloth and everything falls. Set in rows with its chairs.
mesa_restaurante_vestida.imagen: Footprint of “Restaurant table with cloth”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

mesa_corrida_restaurante.descripcion: Long table for a group, made of several pushed together. Walk along its side with a hand on the chair backs until you find a gap.
mesa_corrida_restaurante.imagen: Footprint of “Long communal restaurant table”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

silla_restaurante_tapizada.descripcion: Heavy wooden chair with padded seat and back. It does not move aside when brushed; the tall back is good for counting chairs along the table.
silla_restaurante_tapizada.imagen: Footprint of “Upholstered restaurant chair”: a rectangle, 0.48 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

trona_restaurante.descripcion: Tall wooden baby chair with splayed legs: it takes up more room at the bottom than at the top, and it is easy to trip on a leg.
trona_restaurante.imagen: Footprint of “Restaurant high chair”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

aparador_camareros.descripcion: Service unit on the restaurant floor, with cutlery drawers, linen and stacked plates on top. Waiters come and go to it: better not to stand in front.
aparador_camareros.imagen: Footprint of “Waiters' station”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

mueble_cubiertos.descripcion: Self-service unit with sloping bins for cutlery, napkins and bread, at waist height. Feel along it from left to right.
mueble_cubiertos.imagen: Footprint of “Cutlery and napkin unit”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

carro_servicio_sala.descripcion: Three-shelf metal trolley on castors, loaded with plates. It rolls if pushed and the crockery rattles; it turns up in any aisle between tables.
carro_servicio_sala.imagen: Footprint of “Waiter's service trolley”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

carro_postres.descripcion: Wooden trolley on castors with a curved glass dome on top and cakes inside. The waiter wheels it from table to table.
carro_postres.imagen: Footprint of “Dessert trolley”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

gueridon.descripcion: Narrow wheeled side table the waiter brings up to your table for carving or flambéing. It may have a lit burner on top.
gueridon.imagen: Footprint of “Guéridon side table”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Gu”.

atril_reservas.descripcion: Tall wooden stand by the entrance, with the reservations book and a small lamp. This is where you wait to be shown to your table.
atril_reservas.imagen: Footprint of “Maître d's reservation stand”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.55 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

caja_restaurante.descripcion: Short counter by the exit, at chest height, with the card reader and a bowl of sweets. You pay here when they do not take payment at the table.
caja_restaurante.imagen: Footprint of “Restaurant cash desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

bufe_caliente.descripcion: Long steel unit with pans of food in hot water and a glass shelf above at face height. It burns: find the cold rail to slide your tray along.
bufe_caliente.imagen: Footprint of “Hot buffet with pans”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bufe_frio_isla.descripcion: Refrigerated island in the middle of the room, with salads in a cold well and a glass canopy above. You can walk all round it; it hums quietly.
bufe_frio_isla.imagen: Footprint of “Cold buffet island”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

mesa_bufe.descripcion: Long table covered with a cloth skirt down to the floor, with dishes, jugs and appliances on top. The cane feels only fabric; boxes are kept underneath.
mesa_bufe.imagen: Footprint of “Skirted buffet table”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

separador_ambientes.descripcion: Chest-high wooden partition separating two groups of tables, sometimes with plants on top. Follow it by hand to its end to get to the other side.
separador_ambientes.imagen: Footprint of “Half-height room divider”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

biombo_tres_hojas.descripcion: Light zigzag screen, taller than a person, hiding a table or the service door. Lean on it and it folds up or falls over.
biombo_tres_hojas.imagen: Footprint of “Three-panel folding screen”: a zigzag of three panels, 1.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

puerta_vaiven_cocina.descripcion: Handle-less swing door that opens when pushed either way and swings back by itself. Waiters burst out with trays: do not stand in front of it.
puerta_vaiven_cocina.aviso: Kitchen door: waiters come out without warning.
puerta_vaiven_cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen swing door”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

vivero_marisco.descripcion: Large glass tank on a cabinet, with lobsters inside. Cold and damp to the touch; the constant bubbling gives it away from the entrance.
vivero_marisco.imagen: Footprint of “Live seafood tank”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vm”.

bodega_climatizada.descripcion: Tall cabinet with a glass door and bottles lying inside, cool when opened. It hums like a fridge, only lower.
bodega_climatizada.imagen: Footprint of “Wine cooler cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.68 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

botellero_vinos.descripcion: Wooden unit against the wall made of diamond-shaped pigeonholes, with bottle ends poking out. By touch you feel the holes and the necks.
botellero_vinos.imagen: Footprint of “Pigeonhole wine rack”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.33 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

mesa_aluminio_terraza.descripcion: Light aluminium table with a sheet-metal top and rounded corners. It sounds tinny when struck and wobbles on the pavement.
mesa_aluminio_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Aluminium terrace table”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

silla_aluminio_terraza.descripcion: Aluminium chair with arms and a strap seat. It weighs nothing: the wind or a nudge shifts it and it turns up in the middle of the way.
silla_aluminio_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Aluminium terrace armchair”: a rectangle, 0.56 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “Sa”.

terraza_recogida.descripcion: The terrace tables and chairs stacked against the façade and chained together when the bar is closed. An uneven bulk with legs sticking out.
terraza_recogida.imagen: Footprint of “Terrace furniture stacked and chained”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

sofa_pales_terraza.descripcion: Low seat made of wooden pallets and thick cushions. The pallet edges are at shin height and stick out beyond the cushion.
sofa_pales_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet terrace sofa”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

barra_exterior_u.descripcion: Terrace or beach bar closed on three sides, with the bartender inside. You can walk round the outside following the counter by hand.
barra_exterior_u.imagen: Footprint of “U-shaped outdoor bar”: a U open at the back, where the bartender gets in, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

sombrilla_brazo_lateral.descripcion: Large parasol whose mast stands to one side, on a cross-shaped base weighted with slabs. The base takes up a metre and its arms are easy to trip on.
sombrilla_brazo_lateral.imagen: Footprint of “Cantilever parasol”: a cross, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sb”.

base_sombrilla_suelta.nombre: Parasol base left without its parasol
base_sombrilla_suelta.descripcion: Round concrete base with a short tube, left on the pavement when the parasols are put away. Low and solid: easy to trip over.
base_sombrilla_suelta.imagen: Footprint of “Parasol base left without its parasol”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

estufa_seta.descripcion: Metal post with the gas bottle in its base and a wide hood on top. When lit it roars softly and you feel the heat on your face: the top burns.
estufa_seta.imagen: Footprint of “Mushroom patio heater”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

calefactor_colgado.descripcion: Heating bar hung from the awning or the wall, above head height. Silent; you feel the heat on the top of your head. A raised hand gets burnt.
calefactor_colgado.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging infrared heater”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

nebulizadores_terraza.descripcion: Thin pipe with nozzles along the awning, spraying a fine mist in summer. It hisses and cools; the ground beneath stays damp.
nebulizadores_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Misting line”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.05 metres, hanging 2.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Nt”.

mampara_cortavientos.descripcion: Glass panel chest or head high, on two cross feet sticking out on either side. The cane hits the foot; the glass cannot be seen.
mampara_cortavientos.imagen: Footprint of “Glass windbreak screen”: a thin panel with a foot across each end, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

valla_lona_terraza.descripcion: Low tubular frame with a stretched canvas, on cross feet. It marks the edge of the terrace; it gives a little when leaned on and sounds like taut cloth.
valla_lona_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Canvas café barrier”: a thin panel with a foot across each end, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Vl”.

jardinera_celosia.descripcion: Wooden box with plants and a tall trellis behind, closing off one side of the terrace. You brush the leaves before reaching the wood.
jardinera_celosia.imagen: Footprint of “Planter with trellis screen”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Jc”.

cortina_terraza_transparente.descripcion: Clear plastic sheet hanging from the awning to the ground to close the terrace in winter. Soft and cold; it opens with a zip.
cortina_terraza_transparente.imagen: Footprint of “Clear terrace curtain”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

tarima_terraza.descripcion: Wooden platform extending the pavement over the parking lane. Footsteps sound hollow; at the edges there is a step or a railing.
tarima_terraza.aviso: Terrace decking: there is a step at the edge.
tarima_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Terrace decking on the roadway”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tt”.

atril_menu_acera.descripcion: A post with a sloping box on top holding the menu, on a heavy square base. It stands in the middle of the pavement, in front of the door.
atril_menu_acera.imagen: Footprint of “Menu stand on the pavement”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

repisa_barra_ventana.descripcion: Narrow board sticking out of the façade at chest height, under the bar window, to rest a glass on from the street. The cane passes underneath.
repisa_barra_ventana.imagen: Footprint of “Window ledge bar”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rb”.

cenicero_pared_exterior.descripcion: Metal box screwed to the façade by the door, at chest height. It sticks out a hand's width and smells of cigarette ends.
cenicero_pared_exterior.imagen: Footprint of “Outdoor wall ashtray”: a rectangle, 0.12 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cp”.

mostrador_recepcion_hotel.nombre: Hotel reception desk with low section
mostrador_recepcion_hotel.descripcion: Long counter at chest height which, at its right-hand end, drops to table height and sticks out a little: the accessible section. A keyboard clicks behind it.
mostrador_recepcion_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel reception desk with low section”: a rectangle whose right-hand section, the low one, sticks out to the front, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

casillero_llaves.descripcion: Unit of small pigeonholes hung on the wall behind reception, each holding a key with its heavy fob.
casillero_llaves.imagen: Footprint of “Key and mail pigeonholes”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cl”.

mostrador_conserje.descripcion: Small half-moon desk, separate from reception and near the door, where the concierge gives directions and keeps parcels.
mostrador_conserje.imagen: Footprint of “Concierge desk”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

quiosco_registro_hotel.descripcion: Column with a sloping touch screen at chest height and a slot that issues the room card. It beeps when touched.
quiosco_registro_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel self check-in kiosk”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Qr”.

telefono_cortesia.descripcion: Wall phone without a keypad, at chest height, that rings reception when lifted. It sticks out only a little, but the cane does not find it.
telefono_cortesia.imagen: Footprint of “House phone”: a rectangle, 0.22 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tc”.

expositor_folletos.descripcion: Narrow wire unit with stepped pockets full of leaflets and maps. Light: it wobbles, and the leaflets stick out at the front.
expositor_folletos.imagen: Footprint of “Tourist leaflet rack”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ef”.

sofa_chester_vestibulo.descripcion: Low, firm leather sofa with sunk buttons and arms as high as the back. The leather creaks when you sit down.
sofa_chester_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Chesterfield lobby sofa”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

butaca_cubo_vestibulo.descripcion: Low chair whose round back wraps behind and to the sides, level with the arms. You can only get in from the front.
butaca_cubo_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Lobby tub chair”: a round back and a straight front, 0.75 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

mesa_centro_vestibulo.descripcion: Low round glass table among the sofas, at knee height. Cold, with a thin edge: the cane finds it, and so does your shin.
mesa_centro_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Glass lobby coffee table”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

borne_vestibulo.descripcion: Round padded seat in the middle of the lobby, with an upholstered column in the centre as a backrest. Walk all round it and sit on any side.
borne_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Circular lobby ottoman”: a circle, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.

mesa_floral_vestibulo.descripcion: Round pedestal table standing in the middle of the lobby, with a large vase of flowers on top. It smells of flowers; the vase tips over if you knock the table.
mesa_floral_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Round table with flower arrangement”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

carro_portamaletas_botones.descripcion: Brass cart with a carpeted platform, four tubes arching up above head height and a rail for hanging suits. It rolls with a low rumble.
carro_portamaletas_botones.imagen: Footprint of “Bellhop luggage cart”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.65 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

banco_equipajes.descripcion: Low, wide slatted bench with metal guards, near reception, for putting suitcases on. Not for sitting: it is usually loaded.
banco_equipajes.imagen: Footprint of “Luggage bench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

maletas_grupo.nombre: A group's suitcases in the lobby
maletas_grupo.descripcion: A heap of suitcases and bags belonging to a group waiting for the coach, in the middle of the lobby. Bundles of several heights, handles and wheels sticking out.
maletas_grupo.imagen: Footprint of “A group's suitcases in the lobby”: an irregular heap, 2.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

cama_hotel_cabecero_corrido.descripcion: High hotel bed whose headboard runs the whole wall and carries a shelf on each side as a bedside table, with switches and sockets. Walk round the foot.
cama_hotel_cabecero_corrido.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel bed with full-width headboard”: a T shape: the full-width headboard with its bedside shelves at the back and the bed coming out of the middle, 2.60 by 2.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

camas_gemelas_hotel.nombre: Twin hotel beds with shared headboard
camas_gemelas_hotel.descripcion: Two parallel single beds joined by one headboard, with a narrow gap between them just wide enough for one person.
camas_gemelas_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Twin hotel beds with shared headboard”: two parallel beds joined by the headboard, with a narrow gap between them, 2.40 by 2.05 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

cama_supletoria.descripcion: Narrow bed on a metal frame with castors, brought in when needed and left wherever it fits. Lower than the room's bed and easy to move.
cama_supletoria.imagen: Footprint of “Folding extra bed”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.95 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

cuna_viaje_hotel.descripcion: Folding cot of fabric and mesh on a light frame, set up by the hotel next to the bed. Soft to the touch; a push shifts it.
cuna_viaje_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel travel cot”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

portamaletas_plegable.descripcion: Low scissor stand with straps, where the suitcase is opened. Light and knee high: the first thing you trip over when you walk in.
portamaletas_plegable.imagen: Footprint of “Folding luggage rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

escritorio_tocador_hotel.descripcion: Long, narrow top against the wall serving as desk and dressing table, with a mirror on the wall above and a chair tucked under it.
escritorio_tocador_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel desk and dressing table”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Et”.

armario_abierto_hotel.descripcion: Doorless wardrobe recess near the entrance: two sides, a rail of captive hangers and a top shelf holding the safe.
armario_abierto_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Open hotel wardrobe with hangers”: a U open at the front, 0.90 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

galan_noche.descripcion: Low standing hanger, shoulder-shaped at the top, with a trouser bar and a small tray. It is light and tips over with a jacket on it.
galan_noche.imagen: Footprint of “Valet stand”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Gn”.

butaca_lectura_reposapies.descripcion: Upholstered chair by the window with a loose footstool in front. The footstool is low and soft: the cane touches it late and you trip on it.
butaca_lectura_reposapies.imagen: Footprint of “Reading chair with footstool”: the armchair at the back and the slightly narrower footstool in front, 0.75 by 1.35 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

minibar.descripcion: Small fridge at knee height, built into a unit under the desk. It hums very quietly: at night you hear it and it helps you place the desk.
minibar.imagen: Footprint of “Minibar”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

caja_fuerte_armario.descripcion: Small steel box bolted to a wardrobe shelf at chest height, with a rubber keypad. It beeps as you key in the code.
caja_fuerte_armario.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel wardrobe safe”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cf”.

tv_pared_habitacion.descripcion: Flat screen fixed to the wall facing the bed, above the desk, at chest height. It sticks out only a little; you hear it when it is on.
tv_pared_habitacion.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted room television”: a rectangle, 0.95 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tp”.

bandeja_hervidor.descripcion: Tray on the desk with a kettle, cups and sachets. The kettle is hot just after use; feel for it carefully from the handle.
bandeja_hervidor.imagen: Footprint of “Courtesy tray with kettle”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bh”.

prensa_pantalones.descripcion: Upright double board fixed to the wall, from knee to chest, that presses trousers between its two leaves. Warm when switched on.
prensa_pantalones.imagen: Footprint of “Wall trouser press”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.12 metres, hanging 0.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pp”.

secador_pared_hotel.descripcion: Hairdryer fixed to the bathroom wall at face height, with a flexible hose or a hanging handle. When switched on it roars and blows hot air.
secador_pared_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Wall hairdryer”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.12 metres, hanging 1.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sp”.

carro_camarera_pisos.descripcion: Long trolley with shelves of towels and sheets and a cloth bag hanging at each end. In the morning it stands outside some door, taking up half the corridor.
carro_camarera_pisos.imagen: Footprint of “Housekeeping trolley”: a long body with a bulging bag at each end, 0.55 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

carro_lenceria_hotel.descripcion: Tall cage of metal rods on castors, full of used bed linen. It rattles when moved and usually waits by the service lift.
carro_lenceria_hotel.imagen: Footprint of “Hotel linen cage”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

carro_servicio_habitaciones.descripcion: Wheeled table with a cloth, plates covered by metal domes, left in the corridor beside a door after dinner.
carro_servicio_habitaciones.imagen: Footprint of “Room service trolley”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

bandeja_pasillo.nombre: Tray left on the corridor floor
bandeja_pasillo.descripcion: Tray of used plates and glasses a guest has left on the floor by their door. Very low: your foot finds it before the cane does, and the crockery clatters.
bandeja_pasillo.imagen: Footprint of “Tray left on the corridor floor”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

puerta_habitacion_tarjeta.descripcion: Heavy room door with a handle and a reader above it. Hold the card to it and it beeps and unlocks; it closes by itself with a thud.
puerta_habitacion_tarjeta.imagen: Footprint of “Room door with card lock”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

aplique_pasillo.descripcion: Wall lamp between doors, at head height. It sticks out a hand's width and is warm; anyone walking close to the wall meets it with a shoulder or temple.
aplique_pasillo.imagen: Footprint of “Corridor wall light”: a rectangle, 0.20 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ap”.

maquina_hielo.descripcion: Tall steel machine in a corridor recess, with a bin of ice cubes at the bottom. It hums loudly and every so often ice crashes down: you can locate it from far off.
maquina_hielo.imagen: Footprint of “Corridor ice machine”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mh”.

limpiazapatos.descripcion: Low metal unit with two round brushes at the bottom and a grab bar on top. Bring your foot close and the brushes spin with a whirr.
limpiazapatos.imagen: Footprint of “Shoe-shine machine”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Li”.

tostadora_cinta.descripcion: Metal box on the buffet table: bread goes in at the top on a belt and drops out toasted at the bottom. Hot all over and it whirrs non-stop.
tostadora_cinta.imagen: Footprint of “Conveyor toaster”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.50 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tc”.

dispensador_zumos.descripcion: Machine with two or three cold plastic tanks and a lever under each: push it with your glass and the juice pours.
dispensador_zumos.imagen: Footprint of “Juice dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.42 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dz”.

dispensador_cereales.descripcion: Upright plastic tubes full of cereal on a stand, each with a wheel at the bottom that drops a portion into your bowl when turned.
dispensador_cereales.imagen: Footprint of “Cereal dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.75 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dc”.

calientaplatos.descripcion: Waist-high steel cylinder on castors; a stack of hot plates shows through the hole in the top and rises by itself when you take one.
calientaplatos.imagen: Footprint of “Heated plate dispenser”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

tabique_movil_salon.descripcion: Padded floor-to-ceiling panel running on a track to split the function room in two. Closed, it is a wall; open, it is stacked to one side and you walk through.
tabique_movil_salon.imagen: Footprint of “Sliding partition wall”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

photocall_eventos.descripcion: Large canvas stretched on a tubular frame, taller than a person, on feet sticking out front and back. Light: it shifts if you lean on it.
photocall_eventos.imagen: Footprint of “Photocall backdrop”: a thin panel with a foot across each end, 2.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

carro_mesas_plegadas.descripcion: Trolley holding several round table tops on edge, taller than a person, waiting at the side of the room. The edges of the tops stick out beyond the trolley.
carro_mesas_plegadas.imagen: Footprint of “Trolley of folded banquet tables”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

mesa_presidencial.descripcion: Very long table with a cloth skirt down to the floor at the front, chairs only behind it, facing the room. At the front the cane feels only fabric.
mesa_presidencial.imagen: Footprint of “Top table”: a rectangle, 3.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

mesa_coctel_funda.descripcion: Tall round table dressed in a stretch cover that hugs it down to the floor. You stand at it with a drink; light, it shifts if you lean on it.
mesa_coctel_funda.imagen: Footprint of “Cocktail table with stretch cover”: a circle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

sillas_banquete_enlazadas.descripcion: Padded chairs hooked to each other in a straight row for a talk or a ceremony. Count the backs to find a seat.
sillas_banquete_enlazadas.imagen: Footprint of “Row of linked banquet chairs”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sb”.

barra_movil_eventos.descripcion: Folding plastic bar set up in a corner of the function room, wider at the front than at the back. Hollow: it sounds plastic and shifts if pushed.
barra_movil_eventos.imagen: Footprint of “Portable event bar”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

guardarropa_mostrador.descripcion: Counter set in a doorway at waist height, with rails full of coats behind it. You hand over your coat and get a token.
guardarropa_mostrador.imagen: Footprint of “Cloakroom counter”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gm”.
